prior_exposure: Codex read campaigns 35-40, motor equivalence 09, and user priorities before this plan. Historical campaign40 outcomes are exposed; counterfactual body outcomes are unseen. No blinded confirmation is claimed.
limitation: Campaign40 bearing error increased after wind; a changing bearing during tonic advance and alternating neural commands prevent attributing the failure to CNS, effector or passive dynamics from one trajectory.
operation: Restore identical prepared MuJoCo body and roller controller. Replay recorded forward/yaw commands and wind at 25us substeps, without loading CNS. Compare identity with three one-variable interventions. No new motor policy, neural weights or filter tuning.
legal_information: Existing prepared physical state, recorded per-ms commands, wind timing and dose, fixed source only in evaluator. No source coordinates enter the controller. All external replay decisions belong to evaluator.
difference_and_prior_art: Same physical replay method as campaigns11/32, now matched to the full 2s campaign40 and post-wind state. Engineering causal ablation, no claimed biological novelty. It extends saturated-command screening to the actual failed command sequence.

strategic_ABC.A: Priority: diagnose and obtain sustained orientation with current body.
strategic_ABC.B: Bounded later: CNS-VNC-MN signal identification without whole gait integration.
strategic_ABC.C: Later: combine muscles and six legs once orientation and gait work separately.

A_neural_direction.prediction: Frozen postwind yaw commands worsen source orientation relative to yaw held zero; removes a delivered command rather than changing capacity.
A_neural_direction.falsifier: Recorded yaw commands materially improve final bearing relative to zero-yaw control.
A_neural_direction.information: Recorded command only; source for scoring.

B_tonic_advance.prediction: Removing tonic forward advance after wind materially reduces final bearing error because direction to the fixed source changes as the body translates.
B_tonic_advance.falsifier: Zero-forward control provides less than frozen minimum improvement; cannot treat translation as sufficient cause.
B_tonic_advance.information: Recorded yaw command, zero forward; source only for scoring.

C_passive_wind_body.prediction: With identical recorded commands, removing wind materially reduces final error; the disturbance carries a mechanically persistent penalty.
C_passive_wind_body.falsifier: No-wind has equal or worse error; cannot blame the wind as the primary mechanical cause at this horizon.
C_passive_wind_body.information: Recorded commands with physical wind set zero.

arms.identity: Replay all 2000 original commands and wind.
arms.zero_yaw_after_wind: Identity through ms1020 inclusive; yaw command zero from ms1021.
arms.zero_forward_after_wind: Identity through ms1020 inclusive; forward command zero from ms1021.

budget.basis: Campaign32 measured ~10.5s per400ms physical replay; four 2s replays project210s. 600s reserves loading and checks, not tuning. No comparator training. Packaging includes a separate single clean identity replay bounded150s.

stop: Stop counterfactuals if identity fails; preserve failure and diagnose minimum implementation bug before affected arms only. Do not alter algorithm, criteria, gain or source from outcomes. Close once discriminator complete. No Stage4/5 admission or neural counterfactual from replay; neural feedback remains untested.
classification_scope: Causal mechanical diagnostic on one exposed life, not navigation, learning, natural gait or biological equivalence.
